Based on the provided evidence, the current state of WorkflowCoach is a restricted private beta with an official public beta target that is at significant internal risk of slipping.

**Current Phase & Availability**: WorkflowCoach is in a restricted private/internal beta phase, enabled for approximately 11% of active customers, including selected mid-market logistics and enterprise manufacturing clients such as Acme Manufacturing [NL-002#NL-002-S07], [NL-014#NL-014-S05]. It is described as an upcoming guided workflow assistant designed to expand the platform from passive QA to active, step-by-step operational guidance [NL-001#NL-001-S03].

**Official Plans & Capabilities**: The official public product roadmap targets a public beta release in September 2026, specifically scheduled as v2.9.0 on September 29, 2026 [NL-002#NL-002-S07], [NL-014#NL-014-S03], [NL-014#NL-014-S05]. Once released, it will allow admins to ingest procedural documents and parse them into sequential steps. It will guide employees step-by-step, prompting them to confirm completion via checkboxes, text entry, or photo uploads verified by OCR validation, and record each step in a write-once PostgreSQL compliance log [NL-002#NL-002-S07], [NL-014#NL-014-S03]. The phase is also set to be made available to all active Growth and Enterprise accounts [NL-014#NL-014-S05].

**Internal/Informal Risks & Contingency**: Despite the official September target, informal internal sources reveal serious challenges. CTO Leon Grayson stated the September target is "in serious jeopardy" due to high latency during step transitions (up to 4 seconds) and permission inheritance failures where restricted information may leak to unauthorized users [NL-015#NL-015-S05]. Engineering standups and leadership reviews indicate dependencies on the Advanced OCR Pipeline and Okta permission synchronization engine may push the release to November 2026 [NL-002#NL-002-S07], [NL-014#NL-014-S05]. In response, leadership is aligning on a contingency: a limited private beta in September for non-regulated customers with flat document structures, while the full public beta (with cross-workspace permission sync) is deferred to November [NL-015#NL-015-S05], [NL-015#NL-015-S08]. Action items include drafting an internal update detailing deferred features and defining the September cohort criteria [NL-015#NL-015-S09]. External customer-facing messaging remains September 2026, but internal alignment is on a November slip contingency [NL-015#NL-015-S05].
